name: Profithol
summary: Operating across Spain, Profithol, S.A. specializes in the supply and installation of solar photovoltaic systems for a diverse clientele, encompassing both private residences and industrial facilities. The company places a particular emphasis on deploying solar energy solutions for homes. Profithol, S.A. was established in 2007 and maintains its headquarters in Llinars Del Vallès, Spain.
